about: Sim joint angle -> motor command: motor_deg = zero_deg + sign * scale * sim_deg. sim_range_deg is the joint range in IK/motion2/arm/arm.xml (tests check it). AK45 commands also stay within zero_deg +- limit_deg (set to cover the sim range, 2026-11-05; it was 15 before); servo commands within 0..180. verified=false means the joint/motor pairing, sign and zero are still assumptions (2026-11-05).

joints.name: AK45_4
joints.note: widened from +-105 (model +-100) to +-135 on 2026-11-20 (user); forearm/upper-arm clearance at the ends not checked on the real arm.

joints.name: W_YAW
joints.note: sim wrist_pitch turns about the forearm (axis along it at sim 0, IK/motion2/arm/arm.xml; the CAD joint names are swapped), so it drives the servo named W_YAW. Swapped from W_PITCH on 2026-11-20 (user); the real servo's motion is not checked yet. zero_deg 20 -> 90 on 2026-11-24 (user re-mounted the horn so servo 90 = sim 0): the RL policy needs down to -78 deg here, which servo 0..180 with zero 20 could not reach. sim_range stays +-180 (servo clips, upstream c426a0b): with zero 90 the servo allows sim -90..90.

joints.name: W_PITCH
joints.note: sim wrist_yaw bends the wrist (axis parallel to the elbow's at sim 0), so it drives the servo named W_PITCH. 2026-11-25 user: servo 70 is exactly the origin (checked on the arm), but IK grasps landed ~7 cm past the cube; bending -20 deg more at the grasp pose (sim -81.8) grasps exactly (model: -20 deg there moves the tip 8.3 cm toward the robot). Origin right + error growing with angle = scale, not zero: scale 0.6667 -> 0.8297.

joints.name: F1_2
joints.note: 2026-11-25 user (servo table): this servo angle is the origin -> zero 70.6 -> 45.6. Servo 0 is sim -45.6, so the planner's full open (-60) holds the servo end (clip_ok).

joints.name: F2_2
joints.note: 2026-11-25 user: straight = servo 0 (the end of the servo), and a bigger servo angle bends the tip OUTWARD, so there is no inward travel with this horn. sim 0 = straight (servo 0); sign -1 makes any curl command clip to straight instead of bending outward (clip_ok). To curl inward, re-seat the horn with the tip straight at servo 90, then zero_deg 90.
